critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py L1017 & L1072 still contain a 'photo': 'Profile Photo' key inside step_names label-translation dicts used only by /approve-step and /reject-step endpoints. These do NOT surface a photo step in any list returned to the UI — the actual document list (L803-812 steps[] and L1095-1103 step_definitions) excludes it. The leftover dict entries are dead branches (the photo stepId can never be sent by the UI anymore), so functionally benign, but worth cleaning up for clarity.

Test trainer test_trainer_iter25 has verificationStatus='rejected' and tier=None in DB, so without the new test's direct-DB seed mutation, the trainer is invisible to /trainers/nearby. Real users would expect an admin to approve. Not a bug, just a seeding observation.

Preview web URL (https://highlight-vibe-bugs.preview.emergentagent.com/) continues to serve the Expo default Welcome page. Until the expo web entry is fixed, no Playwright-based UI verification is possible against the preview host. Suggest E1 investigate /app/frontend/index.js / app/_layout.tsx web-entry resolution and/or expo router web build config.
